problem: The PC cannot ping its default gateway because the router's LAN interface is administratively shut down.

evidence.evidence_section:
The router interface status was checked using:

```bash
show ip interface brief
```

The output showed:

```text
GigabitEthernet0/0 192.168.10.1 administratively down
```

This is the main evidence for the case.

solution:
The router interface was enabled using:

```bash
configure terminal
interface gigabitEthernet 0/0
no shutdown
```

The expected result is:

```text
GigabitEthernet0/0 192.168.10.1 up up
```
actual_evidence:
The router interface status was checked using:

```bash
show ip interface brief
```

The output showed:

```text
GigabitEthernet0/0 192.168.10.1 administratively down
```

This is the main evidence for the case.
